pyqs.subject: Basics of Computer and C Programming
pyqs.notes: Official university paper with complete marking scheme and programming solutions.
questions: Section A (20 Marks): Short answers - storage classes in C, ternary operator, structure vs union, dangling pointers.
Section B (30 Marks): Functions - call by value vs call by reference with swap program, recursion for Tower of Hanoi.
Section C (30 Marks): Dynamic memory allocation using malloc, calloc, realloc, free with linked list creation.
Section D (20 Marks): File handling in C - program to count vowels and consonants in text file.

pyqs.subject: Computational & Quantum Physics
pyqs.notes: Mid-semester question paper covering Wave Mechanics, Schrodinger Equation & Compton Effect.
questions: Q1. Derive the time-independent Schrodinger wave equation for a 1D potential well.
Q2. Explain Compton Scattering and derive the formula for Compton shift Δλ.
Q3. State Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle and show that electrons cannot reside in nucleus.
Q4. What are wave packets? Derive the relation between group velocity and phase velocity.

pyqs.subject: Computational Mathematics for Intelligent Systems
pyqs.notes: Linear Algebra, Calculus, Eigenvalues and Gradient Descent Foundations.
questions: Q1. Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of matrix A = [[2, 2, 1], [1, 3, 1], [1, 2, 2]].
Q2. State and prove Cayley-Hamilton theorem and compute inverse of matrix.
Q3. Expand f(x, y) = e^x cos(y) in Taylor series around origin up to 3rd degree terms.
Q4. Formulate the gradient descent optimization equation used in Machine Learning backpropagation.

pyqs.subject: Front-End Web Development
pyqs.notes: HTML5 Semantic Elements, CSS3 Flexbox/Grid, Responsive Media Queries & JS DOM.
questions: Q1. Differentiate between CSS Flexbox and Grid. Create a responsive 3-column card layout.
Q2. Explain JavaScript Event Loop, Call Stack, Callback Queue and Microtask Queue.
Q3. Write JS code to dynamically fetch JSON data using fetch() API with error handling.
Q4. What is localStorage vs sessionStorage? Write code to persist user theme preference.

pyqs.subject: Fundamentals of Intelligent & Autonomous Systems
pyqs.notes: AI Agents, State Space Search, A* Algorithm, Heuristic Functions & Minimax.
questions: Q1. Classify AI agents with examples (Reflex, Model-based, Goal-based, Utility-based).
Q2. Explain A* search algorithm. Prove its admissibility and optimality conditions.
Q3. Minimax algorithm with Alpha-Beta pruning: trace on a tree with branching factor 2 and depth 3.
Q4. Knowledge representation using First Order Predicate Logic (FOPL) and Resolution refutation.

pyqs.subject: Technical Training - Advance Programming in C
pyqs.notes: Bitwise Manipulation, Function Pointers, Memory Management & Data Structures.
questions: Q1. Implement bitwise functions to: (a) Count set bits, (b) Swap nibbles, (c) Check power of 2.
Q2. What are function pointer arrays? Implement a calculator dispatch table.
Q3. Write C code for circular queue using dynamic memory allocation.
Q4. Explain memory alignment, structure padding and #pragma pack directives.

pyqs.subject: Environmental Studies-I
pyqs.notes: Ecosystem dynamics, Biodiversity conservation, Pollution control & Green Energy.
questions: Q1. Describe the 10% energy transfer law in trophic levels of an ecosystem.
Q2. Distinguish between In-situ and Ex-situ biodiversity conservation methods.
Q3. Discuss the biochemical effects of particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10) on human health.
Q4. Explain the salient features of the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974.

pyqs.subject: Communication & Professional Skills - I
pyqs.notes: Professional Etiquette, Business Correspondence, Verbal & Non-Verbal Skills.
questions: Q1. Elaborate on the 7 Cs of Business Communication with contextual workplace examples.
Q2. Draft a formal email to Department Head requesting permission for technical symposium.
Q3. Analyze kinesics and proxemics in professional group discussions and job interviews.
Q4. Define psychological and semantic barriers to communication and methods to overcome them.
